source: Original work for Hexfall, except the piece models (see credits). Terrain tiles (tiles/forest|pasture|fields|hills|mountains|desert.webp): AI-generated with Creative Claw (Nano Banana 2) from text prompts only, with no image inputs or reference art, then approved by the project owner on 2026-11-04. The sea is a procedural shader that also samples two seamless textures (water/caustics|sand.webp): AI-generated with the Gemini image API (Nano Banana) from text prompts only (tools/sea-gen.mjs), made seamless by an offset cross-fade, with the owner-supplied reference screenshot used for style guidance only (never uploaded, copied or traced), then approved by the project owner on 2026-11-06. Harbor badges (harbors/brick|grain|lumber|ore|wool.webp): square crops of the resource card art, which is cropped from the terrain tiles by tools/cards-from-tiles.mjs. Piece models (models/road|settlement|city.glb): converted from STL models by Burgers (CC-BY-4.0) with tools/stl-to-glb.mjs, reoriented, rescaled and with a thinned road. The robber uses its built-in procedural fallback.
